description: This file defines the ImportView class for handling the import module's user interface in a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment. It provides methods for rendering import steps, managing language files, and generating client-server communication payloads.

classes.name: ImportView
classes.description: A class extending SugarView to manage the import interface in SuiteCRM, including step navigation, language handling, and error display.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the import view, setting the current step based on request parameters, and loading necessary import module information.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Ensures language files are cached and includes the relevant JavaScript language bundle before rendering.

methods.name: getMenu
methods.description: Generates and returns the menu for the current module, optionally switching language contexts.

methods.name: _getModuleTab
methods.description: Determines what tab the import module belongs to, defaulting to 'Home' if unspecified.

methods.name: sendJsonOutput
methods.description: Outputs a JSON object containing HTML, scripts, and other UI data to the client, optionally sanitizing the output.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Prepares the title parameters for the module view, including the current step.

methods.name: getInstruction
methods.description: Retrieves and formats import instructions for display, based on language strings.

methods.name: _showImportError
methods.description: Renders an error message template for import failures, passing context variables to the Smarty template engine.
